description: Implement deterministic contract sealing with seal_contract(). Renames calculate_contract_hash() to seal_contract() and ensures deterministic SHA-256 by excluding both contract_id and contract_hash from hash calculation. Adds comprehensive tests for determinism, same snapshot → same hash, modified snapshot → different hash. Independent of other features (can be done in parallel)
steps: 1. In services/project-ai/app/contracts/engineering_contract.py, rename function calculate_contract_hash(contract: EngineeringContract) -> str to seal_contract(contract: EngineeringContract) -> str (around line 166). Update docstring to: 'Seal contract with deterministic SHA-256 hash excluding contract_id and contract_hash. The hash is calculated from canonical JSON representation, ensuring same contract data always produces same hash'

2. In seal_contract() function body, update model_dump() call to exclude both fields: exclude={'contract_id', 'contract_hash'} (currently line 177 only excludes contract_hash). Add comment: '# Exclude contract_id (unique identifier) and contract_hash (prevents circular dependency)'

3. Verify JSON serialization uses sort_keys=True (already present at line 181) and ensure_ascii=False for determinism. Add assertion comment: '# sort_keys=True ensures deterministic key ordering across runs'

4. Update all imports in services/project-ai/app/api/routes/contract.py: change 'from app.contracts.engineering_contract import calculate_contract_hash' to 'seal_contract' (line 10). Update 3 call sites: line 427 'contract.contract_hash = seal_contract(contract)', line 512 'recalculated_hash = seal_contract(contract)'

5. Update tests/unit/test_engineering_contract.py: change import from calculate_contract_hash to seal_contract (line 15). Update all 15 call sites in test functions (lines 140, 151, 152, 158, 163, 169, 174, 179, 185, 220, 221, 281, 291, 299, 303, 331, 358). Keep test names like test_calculate_contract_hash_* for backward compatibility or rename to test_seal_contract_*
6. Update tests/unit/test_contract_routes.py: change import from calculate_contract_hash to seal_contract (line 20), update call sites
7. Update tests/integration/test_w2_contract_generation.py: change import from calculate_contract_hash to seal_contract (line 25), update 5 call sites (lines 264, 265, 292, 297)
8. Update tests/e2e/test_m2_9_golden_e2e.py: change import from calculate_contract_hash to seal_contract (line 31), update 2 call sites (lines 338, 342)

9. Add new tests to tests/unit/test_engineering_contract.py: test_seal_contract_excludes_contract_id() that creates two contracts with same content but different contract_id, calls seal_contract on both, verifies hashes are identical. Add test_same_snapshot_produces_same_hash() that calls build_contract twice with identical snapshot, constructs EngineeringContract from each, seals both, verifies identical hashes. Add test_modified_snapshot_produces_different_hash() that builds contracts from two snapshots differing only in one evidence contentHash, verifies different hashes

10. Create tests/unit/test_contract_serialization.py with: test_contract_serialization_deterministic() that creates one contract, serializes to JSON 10 times in loop, verifies all outputs identical. test_contract_hash_stable_across_runs() that creates 100 identical contracts in loop, seals each, verifies all hashes identical. test_json_key_ordering() that verifies JSON output has sorted keys. test_unicode_handling() that creates contract with unicode strings in educational_contract, verifies hash is stable

11. Run python -m pytest tests/unit/test_engineering_contract.py tests/unit/test_contract_serialization.py tests/unit/test_contract_routes.py tests/integration/test_w2_contract_generation.py -v and verify all tests pass
